title: ReadMore-2
body_text: The painting I want to write about is The Red Room by Henri Matisse. This painting shows a red room with a window. In the room, there are two chairs and a big table. We also see a woman who is setting the table. I like the red color of this painting. I think that the room feels warm because of it.
